name: Dream
overview: Scripture reveals that God communicates important messages through dreams, often providing guidance or warnings, as seen when God warned Abimelech about Sarah in a dream (Genesis 20:3) and instructed Laban to be cautious in his dealings with Jacob (Genesis 31:24). Dreams can also be a means of divine revelation, exemplified by Jacob’s vision of a ladder reaching to heaven with angels ascending and descending (Genesis 28:12). Additionally, dreams require interpretation, a gift belonging to God, as Joseph demonstrated when interpreting the dreams of others (Genesis 40:8), highlighting the spiritual significance and purpose behind dreams in God’s providence.
